name: impact-behaviour-observation-checklist
description: Builds a blank observation sheet for a programme's critical behaviours and the group tally that goes with it, producing behaviours written as things a person can see, three marks per behaviour (seen, not seen, no occasion), a no-name rule, a note on what blocked each behaviour and a tally by group. Use for "run impact-behaviour-observation-checklist", "behaviour observation checklist", "observe training transfer", "level 3 observation", "is the training showing up in the work", "on the job observation form", "observation tally by group", part of the Claude Guide for Training Impact Pack by 90n.
